results.name: Observation-enforcement separation theorem
results.statement: Injective/separating records certify whether a composition defect is zero but do not force the defect map itself to vanish.

results.name: Complete records imply associative composition or n=3
results.statement: The octonions have a seven-dimensional associator sector fully separated by seven imaginary-coordinate records while remaining nonassociative; n=7 therefore survives complete defect visibility.

results.name: Octonion alternative normed-division boundary
results.statement: Octonion alternativity, positive norm composition and nonassociativity are established mathematics.

results.name: Random complete-record stress audit
results.statement: All 3000 seeded random nonzero octonion associators were detected by the seven-coordinate record family.

results.name: PDT-native composition-defect suppression principle
results.statement: PDT still needs an independently derived structural/dynamical principle that constrains composition defects rather than merely observing them.
